citation: [2009 and 2011 S. Prairie Ave.] Photograph of the Max A. Meyer house's front from the west walk; unknown photographer, undated. Reproduced on chicagology.com, 2009 Prairie.
author: unknown photographer
describes_date: between 1888, when the house was built, and 1911; the Prairie library dates it 1889-1911
repository: chicagology.com (secondary reproduction; the original holder is not named). Prairie library image a20-chicagology-2009-2011-photo, recorded there as 'unknown - link only'; the project's reference copy is the image store's (kevinrhaas/chicago-images, prairie-1904/files/a20-chicagology-2009-2011-photo.jpg), committed at data/sources/assets/meyer_2009_pictures_t1913/.
locator: The whole print: 2009's street front from the walk to the gable's crest, its north flank receding at the left with two tall stacks, and the left half of 2011's front at the right.
rights_note: A secondary web reproduction whose original source and rights are not stated (the Prairie library's own ruling: 'unknown - link only'). Only forms, counts, places and proportions are read from it; nothing is derived from the image as an asset (no texture, no traced mesh), and the copy is unaltered.
access_notes: Read 2026-11-03 (T-1913) from the image store's reference copy, 1671 x 2000 px greyscale, sha256 03db894ab10dff078b747f611eba3dd8d9bc3b1f35aae50435017dcd4640b4a2. The front is read square on at about 100 px a metre between its north corner quoins (x 390 px) and the party line with 2011 (x 1145 px), whose 7.56 m the 1911 sheet gives.
note: The one clear view of the house: a narrow party-wall front of rough brick over a rock-faced stone basement; a straight stoop between stone cheek walls to an arched door at the south end under a carved panel and pinnacled surround; a four-light window on the ground floor; over it a shallow bowed oriel of three lights on a corbelled apron under a carved frieze, a small light beside it; a string course; a paired light in a low third storey under a hood; and the front carried up past the side walls into a tall ogee gable with a coped outline, a pair of attic lights and a carved crest. Two tall stacks rise from the north flank.
what_it_supplies: the front's storeys, openings, oriel, stoop and gable, and their heights and places along the front
